name: Reset Post
definingDecision: Choose one common input word that collapses every possible starting state into one state.
differentiator: Manipulates uncertainty sets in a fixed machine rather than constructing a transducer or navigating a known state.
controls: Tap input-symbol buttons; uncertainty set and transition table remain visible; Tab/Enter equivalents.
finiteDesign: Three machines with a bounded reset-word allowance.
endlessDesign: Seeded relabelings and newly verified synchronizing machines; reset-word lengths and alphabet vary within a bounded readable cap.
failureChallenge: A poor prefix wastes the finite word allowance; singleton states win.
generationLevelStrategy: Generate transitions by known short synchronizing templates, verify shortest reset word by BFS, reject trivial one-symbol resets.

name: Quotient Quay
definingDecision: Merge exactly the states with identical future acceptance behavior.
differentiator: Builds a minimal quotient of an existing DFA using distinguishing future words; no output-circuit synthesis.
controls: Select two state groups and Merge; optional test-word input buttons; certify with feedback.
finiteDesign: Three automata progressing from immediate terminal distinctions to multi-step suffix witnesses.
endlessDesign: Verified DFA templates with state/input relabeling and controlled equivalent-state splitting.
failureChallenge: Wrong merges consume review credits and show a distinguishing word; under-merging fails final minimality.
generationLevelStrategy: Compute equivalence by partition refinement and shortest distinction witnesses by product-state BFS.

name: Cutback Case
definingDecision: Spend oracle tests to isolate a minimal failure-inducing subset of an input.
differentiator: Input shrinking with a nonmonotone failure predicate; experiments act on whole selected subsets rather than diagnosing a causal device.
controls: Toggle input events; Run subset; keep passing/failing evidence; certify minimum reproducer.
finiteDesign: Three visible failure-oracle briefs and larger event sets.
endlessDesign: Shuffle event names and generate overlapping minimal cause sets, each validated exhaustively.
failureChallenge: Limited tests and certification credits; returning an oversized reproducer is not enough.
generationLevelStrategy: Enumerate all subsets to validate global minimum and construct distinct overlapping trigger predicates.

name: Clause Kiln
definingDecision: Choose opposing literals and resolve clauses to construct an empty-clause certificate.
differentiator: Clause-set resolution without assumption boxes, conjunction packing or implication elimination.
controls: Select two clause cards and a pivot variable; Resolve; clause history and exact cancellation shown.
finiteDesign: Three unsatisfiable clause sets with bounded derivation length.
endlessDesign: Variable/literal relabelings plus verified contradictory implication diamonds.
failureChallenge: Tautological or redundant resolutions waste line budget; empty clause proves success.
generationLevelStrategy: Validate unsatisfiability by exhaustive assignments and discover shortest certificate by bounded clause closure.

name: Wraparound Witness
definingDecision: Choose a small input that follows a required branch trace after fixed-width overflow.
differentiator: Finds concrete counterexample inputs for an existing bitvector program; no program synthesis or positional encoding.
controls: Increment/decrement input registers or choose digit buttons; simulate trace and certify.
finiteDesign: Three programs mixing addition, unsigned comparison, XOR and arithmetic shift.
endlessDesign: Generate from verified bounded bitvector programs and target traces; enumerate all inputs before admitting a level.
failureChallenge: Three wrong submitted traces fail; signed and unsigned interpretations are shown separately.
generationLevelStrategy: Keep4-bit/5-bit domains readable, require at least two operations and contrast normal integer versus wrapped paths.

name: Branch Weather
definingDecision: Evaluate nested all-path/existential temporal obligations by constructing state sets from inside out.
differentiator: Reasons about every or some possible future, including cycles; neither route selection nor cycle removal.
controls: Select states into current operator result and Apply stage; successor graph and previous set are visible.
finiteDesign: Three temporal expressions using EX, AX and eventual fixedpoint closure.
endlessDesign: Relabeled generated small directed graphs with nontrivial witness and counterexample branches.
failureChallenge: Wrong state-set stages consume credits and identify a witness successor/path.
generationLevelStrategy: Reference set semantics; finite least-fixedpoint iteration for eventuality; ensure AX and EX differ on each suite.

name: Phase Paper
definingDecision: Compose interference operations so amplitudes, including sign, meet a target two-state wave.
differentiator: Unitary amplitude evolution with destructive interference, not Boolean truth tables or classical additive harmonics.
controls: Tap H, X and Z gates; state-vector signs and exact amplitudes are drawn and labeled; remove last gate.
finiteDesign: Three exact one/two-qubit targets with bounded operation ribbon.
endlessDesign: Verified Clifford-state targets from short gate sequences, basis relabeling and varying entanglement.
failureChallenge: Wrong certification consumes credits; basis probabilities alone do not satisfy phase targets.
generationLevelStrategy: Use exact small Clifford vectors with tolerance checks, BFS verify targets and require entangled and signed targets.

name: Rotation Index
definingDecision: Rebuild a message by following stable occurrence ranks through a sorted cyclic transform.
differentiator: Inverse Burrows-Wheeler permutation with duplicate occurrence tracking, not source alignment or substring copying.
controls: Select the next indexed last-column row; choose its ranked first-column successor; decoding trace visible.
finiteDesign: Three transforms with repeated letters and a unique end marker.
endlessDesign: Seeded short strings using3-4 letters; compute transform and LF permutation with independent inverse validation.
failureChallenge: Wrong successor consumes review credit; all letters and the end marker must be placed consistently.
generationLevelStrategy: Use increasing repeated-symbol ambiguity, require stable rank rather than only matching character.

name: Shared Secret
definingDecision: Choose interpolation weights whose weighted shares recover a hidden finite-field constant.
differentiator: Threshold polynomial share reconstruction using modular basis weights; no augmented-row reduction or damaged-bit repair.
controls: Select share subset and cycle each finite-field coefficient; combined polynomial basis shown.
finiteDesign: Three threshold reconstructions, including a deliberately unusable undersized subset.
endlessDesign: Prime7/11 fields, random degree≤2 polynomials and verified distinct share coordinates.
failureChallenge: Only constant coefficient1 and higher coefficients0 recover the secret; incorrect releases use credits.
generationLevelStrategy: Enumerate legal weight choices and confirm unique reconstruction for each chosen threshold subset.

name: Crossed Channel
definingDecision: Choose when a bottleneck should carry a linear combination so two receivers can undo it using side information.
differentiator: Algebraic network coding under capacity, instead of scalar conserved flow or retransmission.
controls: Select a relay operation (A, B or A XOR B) and send on available channel; receiver knowledge vectors are labeled.
finiteDesign: Three acyclic multicast networks with strict shared-link capacity.
endlessDesign: Relabeled butterfly variants and side-information rotations verified by exhaustive transmission search.
failureChallenge: Irreversible sends spend link budget; a receiver must span both independent source packets.
generationLevelStrategy: Represent packets as2-bit GF(2) vectors; only send combinations of currently known vectors; validate receivers by rank.

name: Quorum Garden
definingDecision: Choose read/write quorum families that always intersect while surviving specified outages.
differentiator: Intersection of distributed read/write sets across failure domains, rather than weighted voter support or liquidity.
controls: Toggle nodes within each quorum card; inspect pair intersections and surviving outage cards; Certify.
finiteDesign: Three quorum-design briefs balancing cost, intersection and survivability.
endlessDesign: Small6-node layouts with exhaustive feasible-family enumeration and rotated domain names.
failureChallenge: Too-cheap disjoint sets permit stale reads; oversized choices exceed service cost; certification credits limited.
generationLevelStrategy: Validate every read/write pair and every public outage; budgets derived from a discovered feasible optimum.

name: Bound Names
definingDecision: Reduce an expression while renaming binders to prevent free-variable capture.
differentiator: Scope-sensitive lambda substitution; equal glyphs have binding identity and cannot be rewritten as substrings.
controls: Select a binder for rename, select a reducible application, Reduce; free/bound variable traces shown.
finiteDesign: Three reductions ending in a required alpha-equivalent normal form.
endlessDesign: Curated capture hazards plus fresh-name relabeling; verify through AST substitution.
failureChallenge: A careless unrenamed substitution captures a free variable and loses; step allowance discourages redundant renames.
generationLevelStrategy: Compute free variables and explicit binder identities; certify alpha-equivalence by canonical de Bruijn representation.

name: Separating Line
definingDecision: Place a separating line with a required margin between two labeled point clouds.
differentiator: Chooses one geometric decision boundary and margin, rather than multiple nearest prototypes.
controls: Cycle integer slope/intercept; preview signed margins and misclassifications; certify.
finiteDesign: Three separable clouds with tight geometric margin requirements.
endlessDesign: Generate point clouds around certified integer separators, reflect/translate them, exhaustive-check feasible lines.
failureChallenge: Wrong certification uses credits; every point must be correctly signed and outside the margin.
generationLevelStrategy: Bounded coordinates and small slope palette; include outliers so eyeballing the mean fails.

name: Hall Window
definingDecision: Produce a subset of jobs with fewer eligible workers than jobs, proving full assignment impossible.
differentiator: Constructs an infeasibility certificate using Hall deficiency, rather than finding stable ranked matches.
controls: Toggle job subset; eligible-worker union grows visibly; submit certificate.
finiteDesign: Three bipartite graphs with a required minimum-sized deficient witness.
endlessDesign: Generate eligibility graphs with planted deficient subsets and distracting neighborhoods; enumerate all subsets.
failureChallenge: Wrong or oversized certificates consume credits; a neighborhood count must be strictly deficient.
generationLevelStrategy: Require2-,3-,4-job smallest witnesses; all single jobs have at least one worker and graph includes plausible distractors.

name: Empty Language
definingDecision: Prove which grammar symbols can disappear by selecting justified nullable productions until fixedpoint.
differentiator: Grammar least-fixedpoint reasoning about empty strings; no parsing or regular-expression construction.
controls: Select a production and Derive nullable; mark remaining symbols nonnullable; certify closure.
finiteDesign: Three grammars with epsilon chains, alternatives and ungrounded cycles.
endlessDesign: Curated dependency hypergraphs with renamed nonterminals and added terminal blockers.
failureChallenge: Claiming nullable with an unjustified cyclic derivation spends credits; missing closure fails certification.
generationLevelStrategy: Independent fixedpoint oracle; guarantee groundless strongly connected components and at least one branching epsilon derivation.

name: Credit Method
definingDecision: Assign conserved potential credits so a sequence of costly data-structure operations fits a fixed amortized charge.
differentiator: Accounts for aggregate cost with a potential function and prepayment, rather than storing objects or scheduling resources.
controls: Choose charge and potential rule coefficients; advance operations; bank ledger previews every prefix.
finiteDesign: Three binary-counter/dynamic-array operation sequences with contrasting worst-case bursts.
endlessDesign: Generated operation lengths and initial states; validate exact physical cost and potential balances.
failureChallenge: A negative credit bank or excessive total charge fails; overcharging violates the public budget.
generationLevelStrategy: Explicit replay of flips/copies; potential rules from a finite palette independently checked on every prefix.

name: Interval Post
definingDecision: Narrow a rational coding interval, then choose the shortest binary fraction strictly inside it.
differentiator: Whole-message arithmetic interval coding, neither per-symbol tree codes, dictionary references nor lossy quantization.
controls: Choose successive source symbols from cumulative frequency table, then append binary digits to a code fraction.
finiteDesign: Three exact messages with skewed probabilities and bounded binary length.
endlessDesign: Short seeded ternary messages; integer numerator/denominator interval arithmetic and verified shortest code.
failureChallenge: Wrong symbol narrows to a wrong interval; code outside target interval or too long loses.
generationLevelStrategy: Use exact rational cross-products, varied distributions and repeated motifs; enumerate minimal binary fractions.

name: Pruning Room
definingDecision: Expose selected leaves of a minimax tree and certify root value only when explored bounds justify pruning.
differentiator: Player performs adversarial search and bound propagation, instead of choosing board moves against an AI.
controls: Tap leaves to reveal value; mark justified cut subtrees; submit root value via buttons.
finiteDesign: Three alternating max/min trees with progressively nested ancestor bounds and leaf budget.
endlessDesign: Generate small depth2-3 trees with validated alpha-beta traversal and useful, order-dependent cutoffs.
failureChallenge: Revealing unnecessary leaves spends allowance; unjustified prunes and wrong root claims consume credits.
generationLevelStrategy: Interval minimax bounds for hidden leaves, sound cutoff certificates, ensure full reveal exceeds budget.

name: Privacy Dials
definingDecision: Allocate response probabilities so neighboring inputs have bounded likelihood ratios while accuracy stays high.
differentiator: Probabilistic indistinguishability over distributions, rather than cohort generalization or deterministic quantizer regions.
controls: Cycle integer probability counts in each response row; normalization, ratio violations and accuracy shown.
finiteDesign: Three small randomized-response mechanisms with explicit toy privacy and utility targets.
endlessDesign: Symmetric and boundary-aware2/3-value input domains; feasible integer matrices found exhaustively.
failureChallenge: Unnormalized rows or a zero-probability leak fails; too much noise fails accuracy; limited certifications.
generationLevelStrategy: Exact integer comparisons for likelihood bounds; all public neighbor pairs checked in both directions; no real-world privacy claim.

name: Divisor House
definingDecision: Allocate a fixed house of seats so every district is consistent with one common divisor.
differentiator: Integer representation creates shared floor-division intervals; each seat changes the common divisor window. No liquid composition or physical cutting.
controls: Increase/decrease seats per district using native buttons; inspect exact divisor bounds; certify allocation.
finiteDesign: Three elections with4-6 districts and9-16 seats, increasing population spread.
endlessDesign: Generate new populations from a certified feasible common-divisor allocation, then hide allocation and divisor; bounded district and seat caps.
failureChallenge: Total seats must equal the fixed house; no district may vanish; every divisor interval must overlap strictly;3failed certifications lose.
generationLevelStrategy: Plant integer seat counts, choose populations strictly between adjacent divisor multiples, verify interval feasibility by exact cross-products; no solution helper shipped.
